department: National Savings Institute, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
benefit: A savings account for your daughter. You can put in Rs 250 to Rs 1.5 lakh each year. The account matures after 21 years. The interest is free from income tax, and what you put in can be cut from your taxable income under Section 80-C.

other: The account is opened in the name of a girl child, before she turns 10.
Only one account for each girl.
She can take money out for higher studies, or close it early when she marries after age 18.

how_to_apply: Go to a post office or an authorised bank and open the account in your daughter's name.
where_to_apply: Post offices and authorised banks. The account can be moved to any post office or bank in India.
